layout.spacing_scale: Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) for dashboard density. Generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside cards.
layout.border_radius: Sharp edges. Use rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px-4px) for technical feel.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid background (#15151C), 1px sharp inner border (border-white/10), no shadow.
surfaces.headers: Solid background (#0A0A0E) with hard bottom border (#262630). Avoid glassmorphism to maintain maximum data legibility.
surfaces.buttons: Square edges (rounded-none), high contrast, slight brightness increase on hover. Never use generic soft shadows.

components.charts: Recharts library. Use monospace fonts for axes. Thin stroke lines (strokeWidth={1.5}). Remove default axes lines, use dotted grid lines.
components.badges: Uppercase, text-[10px], tracking-widest, bold. Solid background with contrasting text. No rounded corners.
components.alerts: Sonner toasts. Colored left borders based on severity (Green/Yellow/Red).
components.data_testids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., login-submit-button, machine-selector, download-report-btn).

animation.hover: Instant or very fast transition (150ms). Focus on border color changes rather than background shifts.
animation.live_data: Use Framer Motion to softly pulsate critical metrics. Trigger subtle flash animations when state shifts to Critical.

icons.style: Regular or Bold weights. Avoid Duotone to maintain solid, technical read.

login_background.description: Dark server room used for login page backdrop

admin_avatar.description: Female engineer in hard hat for Admin profile

engineer_avatar.description: Male engineer in helmet for Engineer profile

machine_thumb_1.description: Industrial machine closeup for machine selector

machine_thumb_2.description: Heavy industrial machine part for machine selector

instructions_to_main_agent: Install dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts framer-motion
Use Shadcn primitives but OVERRIDE border-radius to `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`. The design must feel industrial, sharp, and strict.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid layout: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4` with `gap-4` or `gap-6`.
Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric values, sensor readings, and chart axes.
Implement simulated real-time data using a React hook that pushes new data to arrays every 2-3 seconds to animate Recharts.
AI Analysis Panel should look like a command-line output or terminal interface (darker inset background, monospace text).
Apply `data-testid` to ALL buttons, inputs, tabs, chart wrappers, and machine selector items for E2E testability.
Do NOT use teal/purple gradients. Adhere strictly to the High-Contrast Obsidian & Safety Orange palette.
